name: Ellesmere Yard Heritage Tour – morning
description: Heritage Open Days behind-the-scenes tour of the historic canal maintenance yard, including the Dry Dock, Forge, Lock Gate Shop and Pattern Room. Organised by Canal & River Trust.

description: Free two-hour family workshop where children become river scientists: test water quality, explore ways to reduce pollution and save water, then make water-marbling art to take home. For families with children aged 4–11. A ticket must be booked for everyone attending.

name: Ironbridge Gorge World Heritage Day
venue: Dale End Park, Ironbridge High Street & The Iron Bridge
description: Free World Heritage celebration with live music, street performers, local stalls, children's activities, heritage events and the Rotary Family Fun Dog Show.
parking_transport: Ironbridge Park & Ride operates 19–20 September from Jiggers Bank with free parking and unlimited hop-on/hop-off travel for £2 per adult; under 16s and concessionary pass holders travel free.

name: Rotary Family Fun Dog Show
description: Family fun dog show at Dale End Park during Ironbridge Gorge World Heritage Day. Multiple classes with entry from £3 on the day.

name: Water Hero Academy – Ironbridge – 20 September
description: Free two-hour family workshop exploring climate change, green spaces and river health through hands-on experiments, finishing by making a water-hero magnet. For families with children aged 4–11. A ticket must be booked for everyone attending.

description: Free weekly parenting support group for parent carers of children aged 0–5, covering communication and connection, routines, behaviour and emotions, transitions and child development.
